title: Cron Jobs
name: Name
type_unavailable: This cronjob type has no frontend configuration description.
cron_spec_help: Use a standard 5-field expression, for example */10 * * * *.

descriptions.sync: Mirror the source path to the destination path. Extra destination objects are removed before copying new or changed files.

sync.src_help: Source directory or file in OpenList.
sync.dst_help: Destination directory. Sync may delete extra objects here.
sync.max_depth_help: 0 means unlimited; 1 only processes files in the first level.
sync.ignore_existing_help: Skip destination files that already exist.
sync.max_size_help: Skip files greater than or equal to this size. 0 disables it.
sync.min_size_help: Skip files less than or equal to this size. 0 disables it.
sync.max_age_help: Only sync files younger than this age, for example 7d.
sync.min_age_help: Only sync files older than this age, for example 10m.
sync.exclude_regexp_help: One Go regexp pattern per line.
sync.size_help: Compare file size when deciding whether to copy.
sync.mtime_help: Compare modified time. Some storages return inaccurate times.
sync.checksum_help: Use a checksum supported by both storages when available.

cannot_edit_running: A running job cannot be edited or deleted.
